about.intro:
I'm **J4sp3r**, a cybersecurity student in Nigeria building toward blue team and DFIR work. This site is where I publish threat intelligence notes, investigation write-ups and detections, and where I keep a live view of open threat feeds.

Everything here comes from public sources and my own lab work.

focus.d: Tracking actors, campaigns and exploited vulnerabilities from open sources.
Host and network forensics, log analysis and incident triage in a home lab.
Sigma, YARA and Splunk SPL rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
Open-source investigation workflows and cybercrime-focused research.
